prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion"]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Learn the basic shortcuts to summon, hide, and interact with your pet directly on your desktop.", "Start Playing"]
2: ["Your Pet is Ready to Spawn!", "Complete these quick checks to release your pet onto your desktop screen.", "Launch Pet Now"]
3: ["Pet Personality Matcher", "Answer 3 quick questions to discover which desktop companion fits your daily work style best.", "See My Matches"]
4: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Companion", "Select a classic pre-made pet or generate a completely customized pet from your own photos."]
5: ["Sign in with your existing account to automatically restore all previously saved pets and progress."]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Environment", "Checking screen permissions and preparing desktop overlay..."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
8: ["Your pet is getting ready to hop onto your desktop background!"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Sanctuary", "Bring your computer screen to life with an intelligent, playful virtual companion who keeps you company while you work.", "Choose Your Companion"]
